Compound Wahala › Level 2

🪣 Level 2: Where My Bucket?

“Where My Bucket?” = Where is my bucket? Nurse Amaka's bucket is missing. Search the compound!

▶ Play Level 2 free

What happens

Nurse Amaka's blue bucket has disappeared and she needs water before work. Search the compound: the gate, the kiosk, the laundry line, the water tank and more. Listen to Aunty Kemi's clue, find who borrowed the bucket, fill it at the tank and hand it back.

What players practise

  • Searching and listening for clues
  • Helping a neighbour

Pidgin lines from this level

Every Pidgin line in the game also shows plain English. A few from this level:

Nurse Amaka
Abeg, help me find am!
Please, help me find it!
Iya Bisi
Na me? I dey sell bucket, I no dey steal am! 😤
Me? I sell buckets, I don't steal them!
Aunty Kemi
Me I hear drumming near the chairs o... 🥁
I can hear drumming near the chairs...
Aunty Kemi
Listen! Who dey drum for there? 🥁
Listen! Who is drumming over there?
Tobi
Ehn? This na my new drum! E get bass well well! 🥁
Huh? This is my new drum! It has great bass!
Tobi
Ah ah! Gently now! 😅
Hey! Be gentle!

Did you know?

Many compounds share one big water tank, so a bucket is precious. Borrowing one without asking is a classic compound wahala.

When you win

“You found the bucket and Nurse Amaka got to work on time!”
